senses.definition: n.[m.]pl. stinking or worthless things, wild grapes (NH n. unit. בְּאוּשָׁה) (perhaps adj. om. עֲנָבִים cf. Di) Is 5:2, 4 of Yahweh’s vineyard, 𝔙 labruscae (v. further De).
